verdict.rationale: Background automation is a fair question for a note-taking app, but the evidence shows no first-party way to define automations that run on their own. Headless Sync is described as useful for agents and automated workflows, but it only syncs vaults; the automation itself would come from external tooling. Obsidian URI action triggers and the TypeScript plugin API are building blocks a developer could use to construct automations, not the capability itself, so none of these earn credit.
